timeline.event: Eli Whitney applied for a patent on a mechanical cotton gin on 28 October 1793.
The cotton gin patent was granted on 14 March 1794, making short staple upland cotton far cheaper to clean of seed.
John Mercer of Lancashire treated cotton with sodium hydroxide, the process later called mercerization; his original method used no tension.
Horace Lowe showed that holding cotton under tension during caustic treatment produces the lustrous finish now associated with mercerized cotton.
Target reported that sheets sold as Egyptian cotton and made by its supplier Welspun contained other cotton, putting origin testing in the spotlight.
Textile Exchange reported that cotton output fell about 1% to roughly 24.5 million tonnes in the 2023/24 season, about 19% of all fiber produced.

production.scope: global cotton production, about 19% of all fiber produced

timeline.event: Fibroin peptides detected in soil from Jiahu tombs in Henan are presented as evidence of silk use about 8,500 years ago.
According to Procopius, monks brought silkworms to Constantinople for Justinian I, founding a Byzantine silk industry.
The FTC issued an interpretation requiring disclosure of metallically weighted silk and the share of weighting.
The FTC repealed that weighted-silk interpretation at 16 CFR 14.4, effective 15 August 1995, leaving misrepresentation actionable under Section 5.
A life cycle assessment of Indian silk found cocoon production, not weaving, dominated impacts.

timeline.event: Alpaca domestication in the Peruvian Andes is dated to this period in research cited by Kadwell and colleagues.
Genetic analysis placed the alpaca with the vicuna lineage and revealed extensive hybridization with llamas.
Respiration chamber measurements showed camelids, including alpacas, emit less methane per kilogram of body mass than roughage-fed ruminants.
Genetic parameters for medullated fiber in alpacas were published, supporting medullation as a selection criterion.
Peru's technical standard NTP 231.301:2022 set fineness and length classes for sorted alpaca fiber.

timeline.event: Angora goats arrived in the United States from Turkey.
Final payments under the US mohair incentive program ended, prompting questions about producer profitability.
Research linked the South African Angora goat's poor cold tolerance to CYP17 isoforms that impair cortisol production.
